For any admissible key k, c.tokenBalance(k) is always a multiple of 20 (0 or the full airdrop grant of 20), which the mutant violates because a successful airDrop credits only 10.

In the reference contract every admissible airdrop recipient's tokenBalance never exceeds 20 (an address with a balance can never receive another airdrop due to hasNoBalance), while the mutant lets balances grow to 40 or more, so asserting balance<=20 after all airdrops holds for C and fails for M.

For any caller passing the supportsToken check with zero balance, airDrop succeeds; the reentrancy lock must be released after each call so a second, different eligible caller can still successfully airdrop — the mutant never releases the lock, so the second eligible caller's call reverts.
